metadata.title: MGS MOLA MEGDR 128 pixels/degree topography crop
metadata.source: NASA Mars Global Surveyor MOLA Science Team, David E. Smith, Goddard Space Flight Center; archived by NASA PDS Geosciences Node, Washington University in St. Louis.
metadata.vertical_reference: Topography = planetary radius minus areoid radius; GMM3 (mgm1025), degree/order50, per source PDS3 description.
metadata.coordinate_convention: IAU2000 body-fixed planetocentric latitude, positive-east longitude, degrees
metadata.projection: Simple cylindrical/equirectangular; sphere radius3396.0 km, central meridian180°, latitude0°, standard parallel0°.
metadata.resolution_note: 0.463km is north-south and equatorial spacing. East-west ground spacing decreases with cos(latitude): about327m at45N. Bins without observations contain interpolated values. Up to12km source profile gaps are documented; grid spacing is not independent measurement resolution.
metadata.bounds_semantics: Outer pixel edges. Arrays contain pixel-center coordinates. Latitude decreases north to south; longitude increases west to east; elevation_m[row,col].
metadata.missing_data: No missing-value sentinel is declared in the source label. Source interpolation fills unsampled bins; valid values do not guarantee observed shots in each cell.
metadata.read_method: HTTP206 contiguous full-width rows followed by column crop; no interpolation or value changes.
metadata.source_full_hash_note: Full129761280-byte IMG not downloaded. SHA256 above verifies the exact downloaded byte range; no claim is made to full-file hashing.
metadata.slope_guidance: Derive a regional grid-gradient slope using Mars radius and cos(latitude), report degrees. Do not treat as measured local EVA terrain slope or a certified safe path.

derivation.slope: atan(hypot(dz/dx,dz/dy)), Mars mean radius and latitude cosine correction; regional grid gradient only
